highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves rendering responsiveness, memory retention, and managed interop performance across supported platforms.
highlights_body: Android texture rendering now follows display refresh, while pixel operations and text shaping avoid avoidable work. WebGPU support is included directly in native artifacts, and front-buffered streams no longer retain more data than necessary.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering synchronized with display refresh
bullets.detail: Texture-backed Android rendering now coordinates presentation with the display refresh cycle, improving visual responsiveness.
Front-buffered stream handling no longer retains buffered content unnecessarily, reducing memory pressure for consumers that read streams incrementally.
Managed image pixel-copy paths avoid unnecessary work, improving throughput when applications move pixel data between SkiaSharp and managed buffers.
HarfBuzz text input reuses UTF-32 buffers, and feature-string processing no longer allocates native memory while preserving existing decoding behavior.

bullets.lead: WebGPU implementation ships in native artifacts
bullets.detail: The native SkiaSharp library now includes emdawnwebgpu's WebGPU implementation, making the required support available with the shipped artifact.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Included the emdawnwebgpu WebGPU implementation in the native SkiaSharp library
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Improved reliability of the Blazor CPU sample tests by waiting for the first canvas paint
